name: Clay Kaytis
bio:
Clay Kaytis (born March 22, 1973) is an American animator and film director, best known for directing the animated film The Angry Birds Movie (2016), the Christmas comedy film The Christmas Chronicles (2018), and the A Christmas Story sequel A Christmas Story Christmas (2022).

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

credits.title: Best Christmas Movies Ever!
credits.overview: Over 50 stars, writers, athletes, directors and critics share the spirit of the season.

credits.title: A Christmas Story Christmas
credits.overview: Follows Ralphie, now adult, who returns to the house on Cleveland Street to give his kids a magical Christmas like the one he had as a child, reconnecting with childhood friends, and reconciling the passing of his Old Man.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: To Mom (and Dad), with Love
credits.overview: Mother's Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it's a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.

credits.title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne
credits.overview: After finding out her grandmother won't be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year's Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.

credits.title: The Christmas Chronicles
credits.overview: Siblings Kate and Teddy try to prove Santa Claus is real, but when they accidentally cause his sleigh to crash, they have to save Christmas.

credits.title: The Angry Birds Movie
credits.overview: An island populated entirely by happy, flightless birds or almost entirely. In this paradise, Red, a bird with a temper problem, speedy Chuck, and the volatile Bomb have always been outsiders.
